card.name: Software click instructions before a button
card.fires_on: Words in step-by-step computer instructions right before a button or key name is expected, such as 'click the' then button, or 'select it, and' then click. Seen in software tutorials.

modes.label: The word button
modes.description: The word button itself after 'click the' in on-screen instructions.

modes.label: Linking word before click
modes.description: A linking word or comma between steps, right before 'click' and a button or menu name.

modes.label: Keyboard key steps
modes.description: Words inside key-press instructions, such as key or a key name part.
modes.example: pressing the F4<< key>> on the keyboard

card.writes: It suppresses the word button in many forms, so it lowers the chance that button comes next.
card.plain: It fires in software how-to steps where the next word might be 'button', and it holds that word back.
